name.ja: 幾何マルチグリッドVサイクル

summary.ja: 既存配布版：細格子で平滑化し、粗格子で滑らかな誤差を補正する幾何学的多重格子法。公開実装は単位正方形の零Dirichlet Poisson問題に対する固定階層のV-cycle。 追加固定例：係数ジャンプ拡散：共有流束とMG・AMG、回転異方性拡散：完全テンソルQ1とMG・AMG。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Existing releases: Geometric multigrid combines fine-grid smoothing with coarse-grid correction of smooth error. The public implementation is a fixed-hierarchy V-cycle for zero-Dirichlet Poisson on the unit square. Additional fixed examples: Checkerboard diffusion: shared flux, MG and AMG, Rotated diffusion: full-tensor Q1, MG and AMG. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

references.label: Brandt, A. (1977). Multi-Level Adaptive Solutions to Boundary-Value Problems.
references.scope: Multilevel interaction for boundary-value solvers; the atlas implements only a fixed nested-grid geometric V-cycle.

supports.ja: 粗密の格子間で情報を交換する多重格子法の一次研究。論文中の適応格子機能を実装済みとはしない。
supports.en: Primary multilevel boundary-value research; its adaptive capabilities are not claimed for the fixed-grid atlas example.

verification.locator: Abstract on printed p. 333 available in indexed primary-paper text; full PDF fetched but no readable body extracted. Author bibliography separately checked.

assumptions: Constant-coefficient −Δu=f on a uniform square interior grid with n=2^k−1 per axis.
Coarse operators are rediscretized five-point operators; restriction is full weighting, prolongation bilinear, with three red-black Gauss–Seidel pre/post sweeps by default.
The one-unknown coarsest problem is solved exactly. Entry points use either mixed absolute/relative residual stopping or the comparison's true relative residual.
units: The public problem uses dimensionless [0,1]² and h=1/(n+1). Dimensionally [f]=[u]/[length]²; residual norms have no mesh weights.
boundary_conditions: u=0 on all sides of [0,1]². Error corrections also have homogeneous Dirichlet boundaries, implemented by zero padding.

limitations.ja: 既存配布版の制約：固定された正方形・定係数・入れ子格子の教育例。AMG、不規則格子、適応細分化、強い異方性や不連続係数用の特別な平滑化は実装しない。Brandt論文の全機能や任意問題での最適計算量を示すものではない。 今回の追加固定例：係数比100の固定例。P1格子差は厳密誤差上界ではなく、特異交点の次数や普遍的なMG/AMG優劣は主張しません。 指定した角度・異方性の限定例。スカラーTPFAを回転テンソルへ転用せず、一般テンソルへの頑健性は保証しません。
limitations.en: Limits of existing releases: An educational fixed-square, constant-coefficient nested-grid example. It does not implement AMG, irregular meshes, adaptive refinement or specialized smoothing for strong anisotropy/discontinuous coefficients. It does not establish all capabilities of Brandt's paper or optimal work for arbitrary problems. Additional fixed examples: Fixed contrast100 example. P1 differences are not rigorous error bounds; no singular exponent or universal MG/AMG winner is asserted. One angle/anisotropy only. Scalar TPFA is not extended to rotated tensors; arbitrary-tensor robustness is not established.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

supplemental_review.level: Frozen fixed-input source,independent review,actual pytest/main and independently extracted ZIP; see each new release for exact reference independence and failed-attempt history.

assumptions_ja: 定係数の −Δu=f、正方形の一様内部格子、各軸 n=2^k−1 の入れ子格子を仮定する。
粗格子作用素は五点差分の再離散化。full weighting制限、双線形補間、red-black Gauss–Seidelの前後各3回平滑化を標準とする。
最粗格子1未知数は厳密に解く。停止判定は公開入口により絶対値を併用した残差または共通比較用の真の相対残差。
units_ja: 公開問題は無次元の [0,1]²、h=1/(n+1)。次元を与える場合 [f]=[u]/[長さ]²、残差ノルムは格子重みなし。
boundary_conditions_ja: [0,1]² の全辺で u=0。誤差補正も零Dirichletで、ゼロ埋め込みにより境界値を入れる。

problem.ja: 定係数Poisson方程式の五点差分連立系。
problem.en: The five-point discrete system for constant-coefficient Poisson.

variant.ja: 再離散化した粗格子作用素とfull weighting/双線形転送を使う、red-black GSの幾何V-cycle。
variant.en: Geometric V-cycle with rediscretized coarse operators, full weighting, bilinear transfer and red-black GS.

ja: 規則的な入れ子正方格子のPoissonを解くとき。
緩和だけでは減りにくい滑らかな誤差と粗格子補正を比較して学ぶとき。
en: Solving Poisson on a regular nested square hierarchy.
Studying smooth-error removal by coarse correction versus relaxation alone.

ja: 非入れ子格子、曲がった領域、係数の強い異方性をそのまま入力する場合。
この例をそのままAMGや汎用楕円ソルバーとみなす場合。
en: Direct input of non-nested meshes, curved domains or strongly anisotropic coefficients.
Treating this example as AMG or a general elliptic solver.

algorithm.ja: 直交FVの共有面調和平均。幾何MGと座標を受け取らないSA-AMGの対称Galerkin V-cycleを、同じ行列のPCGへ適用。
algorithm.en: Orthogonal FV with shared harmonic transmissibility. Symmetric Galerkin geometric and coordinate-free SA cycles precondition PCG on identical matrices.

validation.ja: 非零2材料流束パッチ、残差に整合する収支、直接解の前進/energy誤差、独立三角形P1参照の格子感度。

limits.ja: 係数比100の固定例。P1格子差は厳密誤差上界ではなく、特異交点の次数や普遍的なMG/AMG優劣は主張しません。

name.en: 2D Poisson: CG, multigrid and P1 FEM

scope.ja: 単位正方形のsin(πx)sin(πy)を参照し、CG/MGは15/31/63内部点、P1 FEMは4/8/16分割で細分化。FDの最大誤差と真の残差、FEMの要素内L2誤差とH1半ノルムを独立に評価する。
scope.en: Reference sin(πx)sin(πy) on the unit square; refine CG/MG through 15/31/63 interior nodes and P1 FEM through 4/8/16 subdivisions. Independently evaluate FD maximum errors/true residuals and FEM element-interior L2/H1-seminorm errors.

method_note.ja: この問題に明示的に結び付けられた補助実行例と、存在する場合は共通実行例の手法です。別問題の配布物を借用していません。 SEMはC0連続なテンソル積Qp Lagrange基底・p+1個のLegendre GLL節点と求積、疎な剛性行列・SciPy直接解法を使用。p=2で各方向2/4/8要素、別に2×2要素でp=1〜6。公開済みNumartのP1 FEM・GMRESをファイルのバイト列を保持して4/8/16分割で実行し、両者の自由未知数9/49/225を一致させます。
method_note.en: Methods from explicitly bound supplementary examples and, where present, the common execution example. No release for a different problem is borrowed. C0 tensor Qp Lagrange SEM with p+1 Legendre GLL nodes/quadrature, sparse stiffness assembly and a SciPy direct solve. At p=2 use2/4/8 elements per axis; separately fix2x2 elements and p=1..6. Execute the byte-identical published Numart triangle P1 FEM/GMRES at4/8/16 subdivisions, matching9/49/225 free unknowns.
